# Machine Party Wiki

> Independent English-language player guides for Machine Party. This is an unofficial fan resource.

Machine Party Wiki prioritizes direct answers, official Steam and developer sources, visible review dates, and clear labels for community reports or lore theories.

## Core guides

- [Homepage](https://machine-party.wiki/): Guide directory and current game status.
- [All minigames](https://machine-party.wiki/minigames/): The 15-trial roster with rules and win conditions.
- [Achievements](https://machine-party.wiki/achievements/): All 15 Steam unlock requirements and a local checklist.
- [How to play](https://machine-party.wiki/how-to-play/): Controls, briefing behavior, room creation, and joining.
- [Multiplayer](https://machine-party.wiki/multiplayer/): Private rooms, local-play status, invites, and matchmaking.
- [Fixes](https://machine-party.wiki/fixes/): Conservative troubleshooting and bug-report guidance.
- [Tips and lore](https://machine-party.wiki/tips/): Trial tactics and labeled Tartarus Engine theories.
- [FAQ](https://machine-party.wiki/faq/): Short answers to common player questions.
